base_series: 731 raw daily-close equity values including cash days, with initial100000 prepended only for returns/drawdown
sharpe_zero_cash: mean(r)/sample_std(r,ddof=1)*sqrt(365); null when standard deviation is0
monthly_return: month final equity/prior month final equity-1; firstdenominator100000; all24calendar months continuous, no reset
monthly_counts: fills by execution UTC month; days_long=endclose quantity>0; allzero activity months retained
roundtrip: a buy followed by a sell; netpnl=sale cash_after-entry cash_before; open trade excluded from win_rate
win_rate: strictly positive netpnl/closedroundtrips; zero included denominator; null if no closedtrade
exposure: endclose bars quantity>0 divided by731; no intrabar inference
fee_total: sum exact Decimal fees; represented decimaltext
floats: Decimal values converted to float64 for numpy metrics only; no float in indicators, order eligibility, allocation, valuation
serialization: CSV UTF8 csv.writer default CRLF; booleans0/1; missing empty; Decimal str no quantization; JSON indent2 UTF8 ensure_ascii=False allow_nan=False newline; no timestamps in deterministic results
